channel.title: Fool me
channel.description: If you've ever heard my music on the radio, this is the song... I got a royalty payment for this song a few weeks ago.....WOO HOO.....$.87....Hey.87cents aint nothin..... Anyway, this song was a lot of fun to record. It's mostly live, in the studio. We did add the Organ later, Gregg Dechert is such a monster. Google him....and some other bits., but basically it was Steve Zucalla on drums, Atilla Toth on bass, Tyson Froese on guitar, aaaaaaaaaand my own self howlin away, live....Thats how I like makin records, with people, playing instruments, together.
